judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a main structure for a wooden fruit stall, including a counter.
Add a red and white striped canopy over the stall, supported by two vertical wooden posts.
Display exactly four different, recognizable fruits.
requirements.note: Seven fruit groups are on display, not exactly four: orange circles, red apples, green ovals, purple grapes, a yellow lemon pile, a yellow banana bunch and three plain dark-green circles at the foot of the counter.

requirements.text: First fruit: A pile of red apples in a wicker basket on the left side of the counter.
requirements.note: The apple pile is on the left of the counter as required, but it stands in a plain rectangular wooden crate (flat brown fill with a single plank line), not a wicker basket.

requirements.text: Second fruit: A bunch of yellow bananas placed next to the apples.
requirements.note: The banana bunch hangs at the far RIGHT end of the counter (around x=920) while the apple pile is at the far LEFT (around x=360); the orange pile, the chalkboard and the lemon pile all lie between them, so the bananas are the farthest fruit group from the apples rather than next to them.

requirements.text: Third fruit: A pile of oranges in another wicker basket on the right side of the counter.
requirements.note: The oranges sit in the CENTRE crate of the counter (and top-left on the shelf), not on the right side, and the container is a plain rectangular wooden crate, not a wicker basket.

requirements.text: Fourth fruit: A single, large slice of watermelon resting directly on the counter in the center.
requirements.note: There is no watermelon slice: the only candidate is three plain dark-green circles with no rind stripes and no red flesh, and they sit on the ground at the foot of the counter front rather than resting directly on the counter in the centre.

requirements.text: Include a character representing the stall vendor, a smiling man with a mustache, positioned behind the counter and between the baskets.
requirements.note: No human figure appears anywhere in the render.

requirements.text: Add a small, hanging chalkboard sign from the canopy that reads 'Fresh Fruit'.
requirements.note: The chalkboard does read FRESH FRUIT legibly in white chalk lettering, but it stands against the back wall at counter level on a short post, with no cord, chain or hook of any kind connecting it to the canopy - it does not hang from the canopy.

requirements.text: Depict a cobblestone ground surface in front of the stall.
requirements.note: The ground is a single flat tan band with no texture at all; no paving stones are drawn.

requirements.text: Include the silhouette of another market stall in the background to suggest a larger market setting.
requirements.note: The background contains only sky, two clouds and a sun - there is no second stall, building or silhouette of any kind.
